title: B.Sc Paramedical interns go on strike over demand for monthly stipend

ai.summary: B.Sc Paramedical interns in Jammu and Kashmir have started a strike demanding a monthly stipend comparable to other medical staff, as they await a government decision on a proposal processed years ago but not yet finalized.

facts.claim: B.Sc Paramedical interns at some Government Medical Colleges across Jammu and Kashmir have launched an agitation demanding a monthly stipend on the lines of other medical practitioners and interns.
facts.quote: B.Sc Paramedical interns at some Government Medical Colleges across Jammu and Kashmir have launched an agitation demanding a monthly stipend on the lines of other medical practitioners and interns.

facts.claim: The protesting students have been abstaining from work, raising concerns over the potential impact on patient care services in hospitals in the coming days.
facts.quote: The protesting students have been abstaining from work, raising concerns over the potential impact on patient care services in hospitals in the coming days.

facts.claim: The agitation comes at a time when non-gazetted cadre employees of five newly established Government Medical Colleges are already on strike for the past 12 days.
facts.quote: The agitation comes at a time when non-gazetted cadre employees of five newly established Government Medical Colleges are already on strike for the past 12 days.

facts.claim: At Government Medical College (GMC) Rajouri, the BSc Paramedical interns said a government proposal for granting them a stipend had been processed several years ago, but no concrete decision had been taken so far, leaving them waiting for what they termed their basic financial entitlement.
facts.quote: At Government Medical College (GMC) Rajouri, the BSc Paramedical interns said a government proposal for granting them a monthly stipend had been processed several years ago, but no concrete decision had been taken so far, leaving them waiting for what they termed their basic financial entitlement.

facts.claim: The interns have appealed to the Jammu and Kashmir Government to intervene in the matter, expedite the pending proposal and fulfil their long-pending demand for a monthly stipend.
facts.quote: The interns have appealed to the Jammu and Kashmir Government to intervene in the matter, expedite the pending proposal and fulfil their long-pending demand for a monthly stipend.
